invariants.rationale: The method operates on records, which are assumed to be non-null for method logic to work.
It is standard for partition counts to be positive in repartition-style methods.
If records is non-empty, it's common to expect no more output partitions than input records.
outputPartitions should be within the int range, and this asserts its upper bound for valid input.
Sorting/partition logic on records assumes no element in records is null.
